rule: a seeded draw over LOCATIONS, not over candidates: a place's candidates share one field and differ only in colour, so a split that let them straddle would report a held-out loss that is partly a training loss

config.task: palette-preference scorer v3-gvo (good_vs_okay INCLUDED in training)
config.moving_part: training pairs += good_vs_okay (v3 holds it out); everything else frozen

held_out_from: the vendored production candidate sets, whose locations are the instrument this head is judged on and may never be taught, and the location store's own evaluation pin
